hypotheses.basis: Standard policy reading: 'the exception requires insurance and a health-or-weather reason' defines both necessary and sufficient conditions for the exception to the prohibition. The prohibition on issuing a full refund is lifted if and only if insurance is active AND the reason is health-or-weather.
unresolved_terms: What constitutes 'insurance' being active (policy type, coverage scope)
Whether 'health-or-weather' is a single compound category or two independent reason types

hypotheses.basis: The semicolon creates two independent assertions: (1) a blanket prohibition on full refunds, and (2) a description of what the exception entails. Under this reading the prohibition is absolute and the second clause merely describes a hypothetical exception structure without granting actual permission.
